create_fast_visualizer: create a FastVisualizer instance with metainfo dict containing keypoint and skeleton configuration
draw_pose_on_image: draw pose keypoints and skeleton links on an image using detected instances
configure_keypoint_threshold: configure the FastVisualizer kpt_thr to filter low confidence keypoints below a threshold

review_fast_visualizer_class: review the FastVisualizer class that draws keypoints and skeleton links on images using OpenCV
